Rates accurate as of 04/01/2026. The rates shown are national averages and not representative of FirstBank’s rates, nor are they a commitment to lend. The source of rate information can be viewed here. The APR includes the interest rate, plus average fees and expenses associated with taking out a loan with FirstBank. No points are included. Example loan scenario: The monthly payment on a $300,000 home with 10% down payment of $30,000 on a 30-year fixed rate loan would be $1,751.21 with an interest rate of 6.75%, 6.887% APR. Monthly payment example does not include taxes or insurance, so actual payment obligation will be greater. Application is required and subject to underwriting. Fees and charges apply and may vary by product and state. Terms, conditions and restrictions apply, so call for details. FirstBank Mortgage provides a variety of loan products with different rates, payments and fees. All loans are subject to credit approval. Products and services offered by FirstBank.
